variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.body: An accident has occurred at {facility}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.body: The workplace {facility} has had an accident. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.body: There has been an accident at {facility}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
